decisive_spans.text: Patch Testing Results: Positive reactions to:    - Nickel    - Cobalt      - Sesquiterpene lactone mix    - Colophonium    - Methyl(chloro)isothiazolinone    - Methyldibromo glutaronitrile    - Parthenolide    - Oleamidopropyl dimethylamine

response.rationale: The presence of multiple positive patch test reactions to specific allergens strongly supports Allergic Contact Dermatitis. While Atopic Dermatitis is also supported by the patient's history, the definitive allergic reactions make D4 a more specific and primary diagnosis in this context.
